data.title: 缪尔赛思 · 河岸上的午餐
data.description: 她把水果从篮子里拿出来，挑了一颗熟透的递给你。河风吹动餐布的一角，她伸手用篮子把它压住。
data.action: 坐在野餐布上整理水果
data.camera: 远景，河岸和野餐篮入画
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a pale blue linen picnic blanket spread across a verdant riverbank, Muelsyse holds up a cluster of sweet purple grapes with a radiant smile. Clear sparkling river currents lap against polished stones nearby, with wildflowers, an overflowing wicker basket, and sun-warmed grassy slopes stretching across the cheerful outdoor setting.
